text:
Sam: Heads-up: I'm prototyping a simulated replay run in the console to estimate cost for the late-window backfill. Thinking about adding a 'margin' slider that adds 10/20/30% to predicted cost to be safe. Anyone object?
Ava: Love the margin idea. Is the sim accurate vs real? Last time dry-run underestimated KV-cache reuse and we got surprised. :thinking_face:
Sam: Good point — current sim doesn't model prefix cache hit rate well. I'm adding a parameter to override default cache reuse and sampling. Will run a few tenants tonight and post results.
Maria: Also need to factor in routing fallback. If dedicated pool fills, requests may drop to hosted variant which changes cost/latency profile. Sim should output both baseline and fallback numbers.
Li: We could run a small sample live canary (1%) to validate the sim against production. Add a flag `--canary` and require an approvals flow for >1% so it doesn't accidentally spike.
Ava: Console UX ask: can we show an "expected SLA impact" band next to cost? PMs want to see tradeoffs — e.g., cost vs p95 increase if fallback occurs.
Sam: Yep, plan: sim outputs cost_est, tokens_processed, and latency_p95_if_hosted_fallback. Example dry-run CLI: ```rbx replay --dry-run --window '2026-02-15..2026-03-01' --tenant=acme --cache-hit=0.6```
Maria: Ops note from previous small run: one tenant saw ~18% higher cost due to cache misses + small routing penalty. We should include a default safety multiplier (e.g., 1.2) until we have tenant-specific signals.
Li: Important: quotas. If console shows predicted cost but doesn't surface quota consumption, users will accidentally queue huge replays. Let's add an estimate of compute units and a hard warning if predicted compute > tenant_quota.
Sam: Agree. I'm working on a tokens->compute model and we'll surface "compute units" and block runs above quota unless an explicit override_reason is provided.
Ava: :thumbsup: Also need an API contract for overrides — internal API should accept override_reason and admin_user, and log the approval.
ops-bot: Note: scheduled maintenance window tonight 23:00 UTC may reduce dedicated pool capacity by ~30%. If you plan big replays, please reschedule or pick a later start.
Sam: Good call. I'll gate runs that overlap maintenance and add a modal warning in the console with suggested windows.
Maria: Proposal for default margin: margin = max(1.15, observed_cache_miss_factor). If observed factor unknown, use 1.25 by default. That balances safety and not scaring users with massive costs.
Sam: Sounds reasonable. I'll draft a PR: sim param updates + quota block + modal. Assigning @Ava for UX and @Li for quota API review.
Ava: I'll sketch modal states (confirm, adjust margin, show SLA band) and put frames in Figma tonight.
Li: Will add API hooks and the override endpoint. Ping when PR is up and I'll review the auth/telemetry bits.
Sam: Thanks everyone — will post the dry-run results and a short summary here once the nightly samples finish.
